explain_yue: 數目 1。數嘢、講價錢、排位都用到。
example_en: I need one ticket to Mong Kok.
example_zh: 我要一張去旺角嘅車票。
tip: one apple；a 同 one 都係「一個」，one 比較強調數目。
讀音 /tuː/ 同 too、to 一樣；聽句要靠前後文。
th 咬舌；three 同 tree（樹）唔同，要分清。
讀音似 for、for；寫字唔好同 for 撈亂。
five 開頭有 /f/；同 live 押韻但開頭唔同。

example_en: The MTR comes every six minutes.
example_zh: 港鐵大約每六分鐘一班。
tip: x 讀 /ks/；sixteen、sixty 都由 six 變出嚟。

example_en: There are seven days in a week.
tip: 兩個音節 se-ven；唔好讀成「仙」。
讀音似 ate（食咗）；寫字有 gh 但唔讀出嚟。
同 night 開頭一樣；nineteen、ninety 由 nine 變。
ten 好常用；ten o’clock = 十點。
三個音節 e-lev-en；唔使講 ten-one。

explain_yue: 數目 12。一個鐘、一打都係十二。
tip: 十二點可以講 twelve 或者 noon（晏晝）。
重音喺 teen；thirty（三十）重音喺 thir，唔好撈亂。
同 forty（四十）唔同：fourteen 有 u，forty 冇。

example_en: The train is fifteen minutes late.
tip: five → fifteen（f 變 f，中間變）；fifty 係五十。
teen = 十幾；sixty 係六十，重音位置唔同。

example_en: Gate seventeen is near the exit.
example_zh: 十七號閘就喺出口附近。
tip: 四個音節；seventeen / seventy（七十）要分清。
eight + teen；eighty 係八十。

example_en: Bus nineteen goes to the hospital.
tip: teen 系列最後一個；ninety 係九十，重音唔同。
重音喺 twen；twenty-one = 二十一。

explain_yue: 數目 0。冇、空、溫度零都可以講。
example_en: My phone battery is at zero.
tip: 電話號碼入面嘅 0，香港人有時講 oh，正式講 zero。

example_en: How many tickets do you need?
tip: many + 複數：many people；much 先用嚟講水、錢呢類數唔清嘅。
few = 少到幾乎冇；a few = 有少少。差一個 a，意思差好遠。

icon_idea: an open hand with a few items
tip: 肯定句多用 some；疑問同否定句常改 any。
all day = 成日；not all = 唔係全部都係。

example_en: I go to the MTR station every morning.
tip: go to + 地方；返屋企講 go home，唔使 to。第三人稱 goes。
come 係嚟近你；go 係離開你。come to Hong Kong = 嚟香港。

explain_yue: 想要某樣嘢，或者想做某件事。
example_en: I want a ticket to Central.
example_zh: 我想要一張去中環嘅車票。
tip: want + 名詞；want to + 動詞（I want to go）。

explain_yue: 需要；冇唔得。比 want 更「一定要」。
tip: need to + 動詞：I need to go。唔好同 want 撈亂。

explain_yue: 鍾意某樣嘢或者某件事。
tip: like + 名詞；like + -ing（I like walking）。would like = 想要（禮貌）。

explain_yue: 有；擁有。亦可以用嚟講食早餐。
tip: he/she has；過去式 had。have breakfast = 食早餐。

example_en: I get a receipt after I pay.
tip: get on／off the bus = 上／落車；get to = 到達。

example_en: Can you make a call for me?
example_zh: 你可以幫我打個電話嗎？
tip: make a call／make tea／make a cake；唔係所有「做」都用 make（做作业用 do）。

example_en: Take the MTR to Causeway Bay.
tip: take a photo = 影相；take the bus／MTR = 搭。
give + 人 + 嘢；或者 give + 嘢 + to + 人。
過去式 ate；have lunch 都係食晏，日常好常用。

example_en: I buy fruit at the market.
tip: 過去式 bought；buy something for someone = 買嘢俾人。
help + 人 + 動詞：help me find…；名詞 help = 幫手。
ask someone a question；ask for = 要求某樣嘢。
tell + 人 + 嘢；say 後面多數唔直接跟人（say something to someone）。
look at + 嘢；look for = 搵；look like = 似。
listen to + 嘢；淨聽 listen，唔好漏 to。
wait for + 人／車；wait a minute = 等一陣。
walk to = 行去；go for a walk = 去行下。
過去式 ran；run out of = 用晒、冇晒。

explain_yue: 打開門、窗、盒子；舖頭開門都用。
tip: The shop opens at nine = 舖頭九點開門；open 亦都係形容詞「開住」。
The shop closes at ten；closed 係形容詞「閂咗門」。

example_en: I can't find my Octopus card.
tip: 過去式 found；look for 係「喺度搵」，find 係「搵到結果」。

example_en: I use this app every day.
tip: use something to do…；useful = 有用。
try to + 動詞 = 嘗試去做；try on = 試著衫。

explain_yue: 巴士。香港常見綠色、紅色同專線巴士。
example_en: The bus to Mong Kok is full.
tip: get on／off the bus = 上／落車；take the bus = 搭巴士。

explain_yue: 火車；列車。港鐵市區線有時都會叫 train。
tip: catch the train = 趕搭火車；港鐵口語多數直接講 MTR。

explain_yue: 的士。香港紅色的士最常見。
example_en: Let's take a taxi to the hotel.
tip: by taxi = 坐的士；taxi stand = 的士站。

example_en: My dad drives a car to work.
tip: by car = 坐私家車；park the car = 泊車。

example_en: I go to school by bike.
tip: ride a bike = 踩單車；bike 亦可以指電單車，單車多數講 bicycle。

explain_yue: 港鐵（Mass Transit Railway）。香港主要鐵路系統。
tip: 口語直接講 MTR；出口有字母，跟住 Exit A／B 就得。

explain_yue: 小巴。香港有紅小巴同綠小巴。
tip: 綠小巴有固定站；紅小巴可以叫停，但唔一定識路。
by plane = 坐飛機；on the plane = 喺飛機上面。

explain_yue: 渡輪。過海或者去離島常用。
example_en: Take the ferry to Cheung Chau.
tip: Star Ferry = 天星小輪；ferry pier = 碼頭。

explain_yue: 電車。港島叮叮，慢但好玩。
example_en: The tram is slow but fun.
tip: 港島特色；tram stop = 電車站。

example_en: Meet me at the MTR station.
tip: bus station 係巴士總站；細啲站多數講 stop。

explain_yue: 站；亦可以指「停」。巴士站常用。
example_en: Get off at the next stop.
tip: bus stop = 巴士站；作動詞：Stop here! = 喺度停！
single／return ticket = 單程／來回票；ticket gate = 閘機。

explain_yue: 月台。等火車或者港鐵嘅地方。
tip: 跟指示去 platform；mind the gap = 小心月台空隙。

explain_yue: 出口。港鐵出口用字母標示。
tip: 港鐵 exit 字母好重要；emergency exit = 緊急出口。

example_en: I ride the bus to work.
tip: ride a bike／horse；give someone a ride = 載人一程。

example_en: She can drive to the airport.
tip: drive a car；driver = 司機；drive carefully = 小心揸。

explain_yue: 上車；登機。比較正式，廣播常見。
tip: boarding pass = 登機證；口語上巴士多數講 get on。
正式用語；日常口語多數講 get off。
arrive at + 車站／機場；arrive in + 城市／國家。
on the left = 喺左邊；left 亦係 leave 過去式，意思唔同。

example_en: The exit is on the right.
tip: turn right = 轉右；all right／OK 嘅 right 係另一個用法。
straight on／go straight = 直走；唔好同 street（街）撈亂。

example_en: I need a map of Hong Kong.
tip: on the map = 喺地圖上面；online map = 網上地圖。

example_en: Is the hotel far from here?
tip: far from = 離…遠；how far = 幾遠；反義 near。
go shopping = 去購物；shop 亦可以作動詞「購物」。

example_en: The kids play in the park.
tip: car park = 停車場；作動詞 park the car = 泊車。
英式常講 in hospital（唔加 the）；美式 in the hospital。

example_en: There is a bank near the MTR.
tip: open a bank account = 開戶口；river bank（河岸）係另一個意思。

example_en: I study in the library after school.
example_zh: 放學後我喺圖書館溫書。
tip: borrow a book from the library = 喺圖書館借書。

explain_yue: 超級市場。買日用品同食物。
example_en: I buy rice at the supermarket.
tip: 口語可叫 supermarket／超市；比街市冷氣多、乾貨多。

explain_yue: 街市；市場。香港講 wet market 即街市。
example_en: Mum buys fish at the market.
tip: wet market = 街市；flea market = 跳蚤市場。

example_en: Shall we go to the cinema?
tip: 英式 cinema；美式 movie theater。at the cinema = 喺戲院。

example_en: We stay at a hotel near the harbour.
example_zh: 我哋住海傍附近一間酒店。
tip: book a hotel = 訂酒店；hotel room = 酒店房。

example_en: She works in an office in Central.
tip: at the office = 喺辦公室；post office = 郵政局。

explain_yue: 街道。兩邊通常有舖同行人路。
tip: in the street／on the street；street food = 街頭小食。

explain_yue: 路；馬路。比 street 更著重行車。
tip: across the road = 過馬路對面；road 同 street 有時可互換。

example_en: That tall building is a bank.
tip: office building = 寫字樓；in the building = 喺大廈入面。

example_en: This place is quiet and clean.
tip: a place to eat = 食嘢嘅地方；in place = 就位（另一用法）。

explain_yue: 中心；亦指商場／活動中心。
tip: 英式 centre；美式 center。city centre = 市中心。

example_en: The park is near the station.
tip: near + 名詞；near here = 附近。比 next to 範圍闊啲。

example_en: The bank is opposite the park.
tip: opposite ≈ across from；the opposite = 相反（另一用法）。

example_en: The shop is between two cafes.
example_zh: 舖頭夾喺兩間咖啡店中間。
tip: between A and B；三個以上多數用 among。

example_en: The car is behind the bus.
tip: behind ≈ at the back of；反義 in front of。
inside／outside 一對；come inside = 入嚟。
outside the shop = 舖外頭；go outside = 出去。
副詞：go upstairs。反義 downstairs。
副詞：go downstairs。唔使加 to。
email address = 電郵地址；home address = 住址。

example_en: Hong Kong is a busy city.
tip: in the city = 喺市內；city centre = 市中心。
sell something to someone；反義 buy。seller = 賣家。
pay for + 嘢；pay by card／cash = 用卡／現金俾。
It costs twenty dollars.；cost 過去式都係 cost。
price tag = 價錢牌；half price = 半價。

example_en: This bag is cheap but strong.
tip: 反義 expensive；cheap 有時帶「平嘢唔好」感覺，小心語氣。
too expensive = 太貴；反義 cheap／inexpensive。
free of charge = 免費；Are you free? = 你得唔得閒？（另一意思）
on sale = 減緊價；for sale = 待售（唔一定減價）。
a 10% discount = 九折；discount code = 優惠碼。
英式 queue；美式 line。jump the queue = 打龍飛（唔禮貌）。
customer service = 顧客服務；regular customer = 熟客。
cashier／checkout = 收銀台附近；港式亦講「收銀」。
退貨多數要 receipt；電子收據 = e-receipt。
keep the change = 唔使找；change money = 換錢。作動詞 = 改變。
fit well = 好合身；size doesn't fit = 尺碼唔啱。
choose between A and B；過去式 chose，過分詞 chosen。

explain_yue: 退貨；送返。亦可以指「返回」。
tip: return policy = 退貨政策；return home = 返屋企（另一用法）。

example_en: I want to exchange the size.
tip: exchange A for B；currency exchange = 兌貨幣。
plastic bag = 膠袋；香港買膠袋要付錢。

example_en: Put the eggs in the basket.
tip: shopping basket 細件；大件用 trolley／cart。
closed／open 一對；closed for lunch = 午休關門。
push 同 pull 相反；push the button = 撳掣。
pull 同 push 相反；pull out = 拉出／駛出（另一用法）。
enter the shop = 入舖；Please enter = 請入內。
超市找貨跟 aisle number；飛機走廊位亦叫 aisle seat。
不可數：唔講 moneys；make money = 賺錢；pocket money = 零用錢。

example_en: One dollar is enough for a candy.
tip: 複數 dollars；十蚊口語 twenty dollars／廿蚊都得。
香港少用 cent 口語，多數講毫子；100 cents = 1 dollar。
pay in cash = 用現金俾；cash machine／ATM = 櫃員機。

explain_yue: 卡（信用卡、八達通等都可）。
tip: credit／debit card；Octopus card = 八達通。比 cash 方便。

explain_yue: 銀包。多數放褲袋或者袋入面。
example_en: My wallet is in my bag.
tip: lose your wallet = 掉咗銀包；wallet 多數扁身。

example_en: She puts the coins in her purse.
tip: 英式 purse 偏細銀包；美式 purse 有時指手袋。

example_en: I need a coin for the locker.
tip: coins 相對 notes（紙幣）；toss a coin = 掟硬幣。

example_en: Do you have a hundred-dollar note?
tip: 英式 note；美式 bill。make a note = 記低（另一意思）。
account number = 戶口號碼；online account = 網上帳戶。
spend money on…；spend time + -ing。過去式 spent。
save up for… = 儲錢買…；save a file = 儲存檔案（另一用法）。

example_en: I want to earn more money.
tip: earn money／a living；第三人稱 earns。
borrow something from someone；反義 lend（借出）。

example_en: I can lend you ten dollars.
tip: lend someone something；lend 同 borrow 方向相反，好易撈亂。

example_en: He is rich but very kind.
tip: rich in vitamin = 富含維他命（另一用法）；反義 poor。
money 主題先記「窮」；poor signal = 訊號差（另一用法）。
enough + 名詞；形容詞 + enough（big enough）。
too + 形容詞 = 太…；I think so too = 我都咁諗（另一用法）。
only 通常放喺所強調嘅詞前面：only ten dollars。

example_en: How do I get to the exit?
tip: how much／many／far／often 好問題；唔好淨背一個 how。

explain_yue: 好多（不可數）；問價錢常用。
tip: much + 不可數（money, water）；可數複數用 many。How much is it? = 幾多錢？
total price = 總價；in total = 合計。

example_en: Enter the amount on the screen.
tip: a large amount of money；amount 偏正式，日常價錢多用 how much。
make a payment = 付款；payment method = 付款方式。

example_en: This restaurant is famous for noodles.
tip: at a restaurant；book／reserve a table = 訂枱。
take a seat = 請坐；window seat = 靠窗位。

example_en: I'd like to reserve a table.
tip: reserve a table／room；reservation = 預訂（名詞）。
serve customers = 招呼客人；service = 服務。
main dish = 主菜；do the dishes = 洗碗（另一用法）。
a plate of rice；dinner plate = 餐碟。

example_en: I'd like a bowl of soup.
tip: a bowl of noodles／rice；mixing bowl = 攪拌碗。

example_en: I need a knife and fork.
tip: 複數 knives；butter knife = 牛油刀。

example_en: Can I have a fork, please?
tip: knife and fork；fork 亦有「分叉路」意思。

example_en: I need a spoon for the soup.
tip: teaspoon／tablespoon = 茶匙／湯匙（煮食分量）。

example_en: This soup needs a little salt.
tip: salt and pepper 一對；too salty = 太鹹。

explain_yue: 胡椒；亦可指甜椒。餐枱多數係胡椒粉。
tip: black pepper = 黑胡椒；bell pepper = 燈籠椒（另一意思）。
soy sauce = 豉油；tomato sauce = 番茄醬。
cooking oil；olive oil = 橄欖油。

example_en: Add a little vinegar to the noodles.
tip: black vinegar = 黑醋；港式雲吞麵常備醋。
fresh fruit／air；fresh 反義 stale（唔新鮮）。
raw vegetables；raw 亦有「未加工／生猛」引申義。
boiled eggs = 烚蛋；bring to the boil = 煮至滾起。

example_en: Fry the egg in a little oil.
tip: fried rice = 炒飯；deep-fry = 油炸。

example_en: I bake a cake on Sunday.
tip: baked potato；bake 用焗爐，grill／barbecue 偏直接火燒。
recommend something to someone；recommendation = 推薦（名詞）。
chef's special = 廚師推介；作形容詞 = 特別。
set lunch／set meal；作動詞 set the table = 擺餐具（另一用法）。

example_en: This portion is too big for me.
tip: a large／small portion；half portion = 半份。
注意拼法：dessert 甜品（兩個 s）；desert 沙漠（一個 s）。

explain_yue: 病；唔舒服。想嘔都可以講 sick。
tip: feel sick；call in sick = 請病假。美式多用 sick，英式亦用 ill。

example_en: She is ill and stays home.
tip: fall ill = 病倒；ill 同 sick 意思近，香港兩者都聽到。

example_en: I have a pain in my back.
tip: in pain = 痛緊；chest pain = 胸口痛。比 ache 更 sharpness 啲。
My leg hurts.；過去式 hurt 同原形一樣。hurt someone = 傷害人。

example_en: I have a fever and need rest.
tip: high fever = 高燒；take your temperature = 量體溫。

explain_yue: 咳；咳嗽。名詞同動詞都得。
tip: a dry cough = 乾咳；cough syrup = 咳藥水。

example_en: He caught the flu last week.
tip: have the flu；flu shot／jab = 流感針。唔好同 cold（傷風）撈亂。
have a headache；-ache 系列：toothache、stomachache。

example_en: I have a stomachache after lunch.
tip: 亦寫 stomach ache；eat too fast 好易胃痛。
sore throat／muscles；feel sore after sport = 做完運動痠。
see a doctor = 睇醫生；Doctor Chan = 陳醫生。
nurse 喺診所／醫院；nursing = 護理。
dental clinic = 牙科診所；go to the clinic = 去診所。
不可數為主；medicine cabinet = 藥櫃。英式亦用 medication。

example_en: Take one pill in the morning.
tip: a sleeping pill = 安眠藥；tablet 亦係藥丸。
have a rest；get some rest。作名詞同動詞都得。

example_en: I do exercise three times a week.
tip: do exercise／take exercise；an exercise = 練習題（另一意思）。
stay healthy；healthy 形容生活／食物；health 係名詞。
get better = 好轉；better 係 good／well 比較級。
get worse = 惡化；worse 係 bad 比較級；worst 最高級。

example_en: I have a doctor appointment at three.
tip: make／book an appointment；cancel an appointment = 取消預約。
health check = 身體檢查；check-up = 體檢。

example_en: She takes care of her mum.
tip: take care of…；Take care! = 保重。health care = 醫療護理。
strong body／tea；反義 weak。

example_en: I feel weak after the flu.
tip: feel weak；weak signal = 訊號弱（另一主題用法）。
play sport(s)；英式 sport／sports 都見到；體育課 = PE。
英式 football；美式 soccer。play football（唔用 do）。
play basketball；basketball court = 籃球場。
go swimming；swimming pool = 泳池。動詞原形 swim。

example_en: Do you want to play tennis?
tip: play tennis；tennis court = 網球場。

example_en: Jump high and catch the ball.
tip: jump up／over；jump rope = 跳繩。
kick a ball；free kick = 免費球（足球）。
throw to someone；過去式 threw，過分詞 thrown。
catch a ball；catch a bus = 趕搭巴士（另一用法）。

example_en: Don't hit the ball too hard.
tip: hit the ball；過去式 hit 同原形一樣。唔好亂用嚟講打人。
team member；teamwork = 团队合作。

example_en: She is the best player on the team.
tip: football player；player 亦可指遊戲玩家。
play a game；game 偏一場活動，match 偏正式比賽。

example_en: We have a football match tomorrow.
tip: a tennis match；match 亦有「火柴／配對」意思。
score a goal = 入球；final score = 最終比分。
win a game／prize；過去式 won。反義 lose。

example_en: Don't be sad if you lose.
tip: lose a match；lose your keys = 掉鎖匙（另一用法）。過去式 lost。

example_en: The match ended in a draw.
tip: a draw = 和局；作動詞 draw a picture = 畫畫（另一主題）。
英式動詞 practise；名詞 practice。美式動詞名詞都寫 practice。
football coach；coach 亦有「長途巴士」意思。

example_en: I go to the gym after work.
tip: gym = gymnasium 簡寫；at the gym。
swimming pool；pool 亦有「桌球」意思（另一用法）。

example_en: The kids run on the field.
tip: football field／pitch；field trip = 校外教學（另一用法）。
kick／throw／catch a ball；ball game = 球類活動。
run a race；race 亦有「種族」意思（另一用法）。
hobbies 複數；What's your hobby?

example_en: I listen to music on the MTR.
tip: 不可數；listen to music；pop／classical music。

example_en: This song is easy to sing.
tip: sing a song；favourite song = 最鍾意嘅歌。
sing a song；singer = 歌手。過去式 sang。
dance to music；a dance = 一支舞／舞會。
make a sketch；sketch book = 素描簿。
paint a picture；painter = 畫家／油漆工。

example_en: I read a book every night.
tip: read books／news；過去式 read 發音 /red/。
write an email；過去式 wrote，過分詞 written。
cook for family；a cook = 廚師；cookbook = 食譜。
play football／the piano；play 用法闊，跟賓語變義。

example_en: We watched a film last night.
tip: 英式 film；美式 movie。film star = 電影明星。
take a photo；photo = photograph 簡寫。

example_en: Bring a camera to the trip.
tip: phone camera = 電話鏡頭；on camera = 鏡頭前。
video call = 視像通話；upload a video。
have fun；fun 偏「好玩」，funny 係「好笑」，唔好撈亂。
interesting 形容嘢；interested 形容人：I am interested in…
boring 形容嘢；bored 形容人：I am bored。
英式 favourite；美式 favorite。favourite food／song。
school club；club 亦可指夜店／球棒（其他意思）。
join a club／team；join 後面通常直接加人／組織。
learn to + 動詞；learn about…。過去式 learned／learnt。
TV show；talk show。作動詞 show me = 出示畀我睇。

example_en: She has a talent for music.
tip: talent show = 才藝表演；talented = 有才華嘅。
collect stamps／cards；collection = 收藏品。
travel to Japan；travel 不可數為主；traveller = 旅客。

example_en: We had a great trip to Macau.
example_zh: 我哋去澳門玩得好開心。
tip: a business trip = 出差；take a trip。trip 多數可數。
tourist spot = 景點；tourism = 旅遊業。
tour guide；guidebook = 旅遊書。作動詞 = 帶領。
passport control = 護照檢查；過關一定要帶。

example_en: We meet at the airport at six.
tip: at the airport；airport express = 機場快綫。
flight number；direct flight = 直航；catch a flight。
不可數：a piece of luggage；美式常用 baggage／luggage。
pack a suitcase；carry-on suitcase = 手提行李喼。
pack clothes；unpack = 開袋攞嘢。

example_en: Our room has a sea view.
tip: hotel room；single／double room = 單人／雙人房。
book a ticket／hotel；booking = 預訂。名詞 book = 書（S1 可能已有）。
stay at a hotel；stay with friends = 住朋友度。

example_en: The room has a great view.
tip: sea view／city view；viewpoint = 觀景點。作動詞 = 查看。
go abroad；live abroad。前面通常唔加 to：唔講 to abroad。

example_en: Let's go to the beach this Sunday.
tip: on the beach；beach towel = 沙灘巾。
in the mountains；mountain view。香港郊野好多山。

example_en: Cheung Chau is a small island.
tip: on the island；Hong Kong Island = 港島。
by the sea；at sea = 出海中。ocean 更大範圍。

example_en: Don't get lost in the forest.
tip: in the forest；rainforest = 雨林。

example_en: Visit the museum if you have time.
example_zh: 有時間就去參觀博物館。
tip: visit a place／friend；visitor = 訪客。
tour guide；city tour。作動詞 tour the city = 遊城。

example_en: I bought a souvenir for my mum.
tip: souvenir shop；讀音偏 /ˌsuːvəˈnɪə/。

example_en: Send me a postcard from Japan.
example_zh: 喺日本寄張明信片畀我。
tip: write a postcard；postcard 背面寫短訊。
go camping；campsite = 營地。summer camp = 夏令營。
mobile phone；on the phone = 講緊電話。call someone on the phone。
英式 mobile；美式 cell phone。mobile data = 流動數據。
give someone a call；missed call = 未接來電。作名詞同動詞都得。
send a text；text message。口語 text 當動詞好常見。
leave a message；instant message = 即時訊息。
on the internet；internet access = 上網。口語亦講 net／Wi-Fi。
connect to wifi；wifi password。拼法 Wi-Fi／wifi 都見到。
複數 apps；mobile app。open the app。

example_en: Check the train times on the website.
tip: website address／URL；official website = 官方網站。
email address；寫法 e-mail／email 都得。作名詞同動詞都常見。
click on a link；double-click = 連撳兩下。
download an app／file；反義 upload。
upload to the cloud；反義 download。

example_en: Search for the station on the map.
tip: search for…；search engine = 搜尋器。
send an email／message；send to…。過去式 sent。
share on social media；share with friends。

explain_yue: 發佈（社交平台）；亦可以指「郵寄」。
tip: post a photo；a post = 一則貼文。英式 post 亦可 = 郵寄。
change your password；唔好用生日做 password。
on the screen；lock screen = 鎖定畫面。

example_en: My battery is at ten percent.
tip: low battery；battery life = 電池壽命。charge the battery。

example_en: Charge your phone before you go.
tip: charge the battery；charger = 充電器。free of charge = 免費（另一用法）。
go online；online shopping。反義 offline。

example_zh: 個 app 離線都用得。
tip: go offline；save offline = 離線儲存。反義 online。

example_en: Turn off mobile data to save money.
tip: mobile data；data plan = 數據計劃。不可數為主。

example_en: There is no signal in the lift.
tip: strong／weak signal；no signal = 沒有訊號。
